evidenceCaveats: No capture file: the USB product ID was measured on the K13 R2R; of the KA15 hardware flags only the fixed band count

rangesAccepted.note: Ten bands (a count of 9 reads as 10), USER1-10, all seven filter types and the preamp written and read back on the PC and on phones. The DAC reads some Q registers one lower than written (990 to 989), which the read-back tolerance accepts.

acoustic.note: PK within 0.136 dB with Q = register / sqrt2 (6 of 6); shelves within 0.028 dB and LP, HP, BP and AP within 0.268 dB with the register as Q. The preamp level and its register offset were not measured.

persistence.note: Ten bands and the preamp survived a power cycle in USER9 and USER10 at a 300 ms write gap (Pixel).

settings.note: Contour offers no DAC Settings rows for the K13 R2R: FiiO Control reaches it over Bluetooth only, and over USB the only vendor path is PEQ in the FiiO web app.

tested.beyondVendor: The FiiO web app offers USER1-USER10 with no rename and the seven filter types (it wrote BP, LP, HP and AP, and a read after HP returned type 5). Contour offers the same; its Q range 0.1-10 is wider than the 0.25-8 the vendor apps list.
